description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the AbstractVertxBasedCoapAdapter class in the Eclipse Hono project. It tests start-up behavior, resource registration, request handling, message processing, and limit enforcement for a CoAP adapter implementation based on Vert.x. The tests ensure correct lifecycle invocation, resource scheduling, and appropriate response codes for different message scenarios.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedCoapAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for AbstractVertxBasedCoapAdapter, validating lifecycle, resource registration, message handling, and limit checks.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up common mocks and fixtures before each test.

methods.name: shutDown
methods.description: Cleans up and closes shared Vert.x instance after all tests.

methods.name: testStartInvokesOnStartupSuccess
methods.description: Verifies that onStartupSuccess is called upon successful server start.

methods.name: testStartRegistersResources
methods.description: Verifies resource registration during adapter start-up.

methods.name: testResourcesAreRunOnVertxContext
methods.description: Ensures resource handlers execute on the correct Vert.x context.

methods.name: testStartUpFailsIfCredentialsClientFactoryIsNotSet
methods.description: Checks that startup fails if the credentials client factory is not configured.

methods.name: testStartDoesNotInvokeOnStartupSuccessIfStartupFails
methods.description: Verifies onStartupSuccess is not called if server startup fails.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Tests that telemetry upload fails with FORBIDDEN when tenant is disabled.

methods.name: testUploadEventWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Checks that event upload waits for downstream acceptance before responding.

methods.name: testUploadEventFailsForRejectedOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that rejected events respond with BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetry
methods.description: Ensures telemetry upload responds with 2.04 after sending the message downstream.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Checks that telemetry upload waits for downstream acceptance.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForATelemetryMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection with TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when message limit is exceeded for telemetry.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForAnEventMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection with TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when message limit is exceeded for events.

methods.name: newCoapExchange
methods.description: Creates a mock CoapExchange with preset payload and options for testing.

methods.name: getCoapServer
methods.description: Creates a mock CoapServer, optionally configured to fail on start.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Constructs an instance of the adapter with necessary dependencies for testing.

methods.name: givenAnEventSenderForOutcome
methods.description: Mocks a DownstreamSender for event messages and simulates its outcome.

methods.name: givenATelemetrySenderForOutcome
methods.description: Mocks a DownstreamSender for telemetry messages with specified outcome.

methods.name: givenATelemetrySender
methods.description: Mocks an immediate telemetry message send with specified outcome.
